name: Edgenet Sala Acapulco
notes: Operator site lists Sala Acapulco as a Centro de Datos with coordinates 16.85911,-99.89048; third-party directory also lists Acapulco data centers in Guerrero.

name: Edgenet MSC Seminario Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists one Hidalgo facility: Edgenet Data Technologies MSC Seminario Data Center in Huejutla de Reyes; Edgenet official site confirms a national network of data centers but the Hidalgo facility detail was from aggregator data.

name: UAIG Building 2 Data Center, Pachuca airport offices
notes: State audit/technology notice says the winning bidder for new state offices near Pachuca airport must perform work for the Data Center in Building 2 of the U.A.I.G.; treated as a government data-center project, not a commercial colocation site.

name: HostDime Guadalajara Tier III Data Center
notes: HostDime official page describes its privately owned Tier III Mexico data center in Guadalajara, Jalisco with 20,000 sq ft of data-center space.

name: HostDime Andromeda Tier IV Data Center
notes: HostDime official materials describe the next-generation Tier IV Guadalajara facility, nicknamed Andromeda; design release said construction would start in Q1 2023, and current HostDime Tier 4 page says 100,000 sq ft and 6 MW, scheduled to open in 2026.

name: KIO GUA|1 Guadalajara
notes: Inflect lists KIO GUA|1 at Salvador Quevedo y Zubieta in Guadalajara with 7 MW total power; Uptime award list includes KIO/GUA in Mexico.

name: Megacable Data Center Guadalajara / Guadalajara Core Mega Data Center
notes: Megacable official site identifies Data Center CORE - Guadalajara; DataCenterMap lists the Guadalajara facility at 9 MW, and Uptime lists Megacable Data Center Guadalajara Floor 1 with Tier III design certification.

name: KIO MEX|1 Santa Fe
notes: KIO official page lists Santa Fe KIO MEX|1 in Cuajimalpa, CDMX, with four 650 sq m data halls and Tier III topology.

name: KIO MEX|2 Santa Fe
notes: KIO official page and spec sheet list MEX|2 at Prolongacion Paseo de la Reforma 5396, Cuajimalpa, CDMX; Tier IV-level, carrier-neutral, with two 600 sq m computer rooms.

name: KIO MEX8 Santa Fe
notes: Trade press reports KIO announced a US$70M Santa Fe, Mexico City data center called MEX8 with 4 MW capacity, 79% renewable-energy operation, and substantial pre-sale of capacity.

name: Edgenet MAYIA / CDMX AI-ready data-center hub
notes: Intel/Edgenet coverage says Edgenet launched an IA-ready national network of 30 data centers and MAYIA, an AI-specialized center; Edgenet official site lists CDMX offerings and data-center services.

name: SHCP Principal Data Center
developer: Secretaria de Hacienda y Credito Publico
notes: EPI certification map lists Centro de Datos Principal de la Secretaria de Hacienda y Credito Publico at Avenida Constituyentes 100, Alvaro Obregon, CDMX, ANSI/TIA-942-B Design Rated 3 certificate.

name: Scala SMEXTP01 Tepotzotlan HyperEdge Data Center
notes: Scala announced US$80M for SMEXTP01 in Tepotzotlan, Estado de Mexico, with 5 MW phase 1 and 7.9 MW ultimate critical capacity; certification maps show the Tepotzotlan site.

name: KIO MEX|5 Tultitlan
notes: KIO official page lists MEX|5 in Tultitlan, Estado de Mexico; IDOM project page says the Tultitlan data center has three design/construction phases and total IT capacity of 9.6 MW.

name: Cybolt Managed Services Centro de Datos 1, Metepec
developer: Servicios D.R. de Mexico / Cybolt Managed Services
notes: EPI certification map lists Centro de datos 1 at Adolfo Lopez Mateos 1956 Oriente, Metepec, Mexico, with ANSI/TIA-942-B Facility Rated 3 certification valid through 2027-09-19.

name: KIO ATOM Mobile/Edge Data Center, Cuernavaca
notes: Uptime Institute client story says KIO ATOM mobile data centers are located in Cuernavaca among other Mexican cities; LinkedIn post references KIO inaugurating an Edge Data Center in Cuernavaca, Morelos.

name: Equinix MO1 Monterrey / Apodaca IBX
notes: Equinix official page lists MO1 at Parque Industrial Kalos de Alta Tecnologia, Apodaca, Nuevo Leon, with 12,497 sq ft; Equinix blog says MO1 opened for business after the Axtel data-center acquisition.

name: Equinix MO2 Monterrey / Apodaca
notes: Equinix and Nuevo Leon government report MO2 officially opened in Apodaca/Monterrey; first phase investment US$81M, more than 720 cabinets, total expected investment about US$189M, expansion through 2030.

name: KIO MTY|1 Monterrey
notes: KIO official page lists MTY|1 at Av. Gomez Morin 350 Sur, San Pedro Garza Garcia, Nuevo Leon, as a Tier III-level carrier-neutral data center.

name: KIO MTY2 Pesqueria / Asia Pacific Park
notes: Mexico News Daily reported KIO acquired a site at Asia Pacific Park in Pesqueria for its second Nuevo Leon data center; Baxtel lists MTY2 as planned for 2026 with two initial 1,200 sq m data halls and later expansion to eight halls.

name: NH Solutions EDC1 Monterrey
notes: DataCenterMap lists NH Solutions EDC1 in Pabellon M, Monterrey as a Tier II-certified edge data center; Baxtel summarizes Monterrey market facilities including Equinix and KIO, but NH Solutions detail is aggregator-only.

name: Edgenet Sala Oaxaca
notes: Edgenet official page lists Sala Oaxaca as a Centro de Datos with coordinates 17.02762,-96.72921; national directory shows Oaxaca has one listed data-center location.
